selfBilling.label: Self-billing
selfBilling.help: Lets finance generate payable invoices from approved timesheets for parties who agree to self-billing in Gateway.

fields.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero, with no more decimals than the currency allows.
fields.budgetId: Choose the budget this change order amends.
fields.budgetLineId: Choose the budget line this expense posts to.
fields.costCenterCode: Cost center codes start with CC- and use capital letters, digits and hyphens.
fields.endBeforeStart: The end date must be on or after the start date.
fields.eventScope: An Event cost center needs the event scope it belongs to.
fields.fileSize: Files can be up to 50 MB.
fields.invoiceId: Choose the invoice to apply the payment to.
fields.lineAmount: Enter amounts as numbers, with no more decimals than the currency allows.
fields.lines: Each line needs an account, a description and an amount.
fields.name: Enter a name.
fields.number: Invoice numbers are up to 100 characters.
fields.oneSide: Each line takes either a debit or a credit, not both and not neither.
fields.quantity: Enter a quantity of zero or more.
fields.rate: Enter a rate greater than zero.
fields.reason: Enter a reason; it is recorded in the history.
fields.source: Enter where the rate comes from.
fields.title: Enter a title.
fields.toLineId: Choose a line of the same budget to draw onto.
fields.unbalanced: Debits and credits must be equal before the entry is prepared.
fields.unitPrice: Enter a price of zero or more, or leave it blank for Unpriced.
fields.urid: Choose a canon discipline or category.
fields.xyz: Choose the XYZ tag; a discipline needs it declared.
fields.zeroNeedsNoCost: A zero price needs No cost checked; otherwise leave the price blank.

refusals.unknown: The database refused this change under rule {rule}.
refusals.budget_line_budget_immutable: A budget line stays in its budget.
refusals.budget_line_xyz_basis: An XYZ tag with basis Category must equal the category's tag; declare it instead to differ.
refusals.change_order_budget_project: A change order amends a budget of its own project.
refusals.change_order_immutable: A change order keeps its requester, number, project and budget.
refusals.change_order_line_budget: A change order line adjusts a line of the change order's budget.
refusals.change_order_line_immutable: A line stays on its change order.
refusals.change_order_locked: Lines change only while the change order is Proposed. Rework it first.
refusals.change_order_not_priced: Only a priced change order can be approved. Price every line, then mark it priced.
refusals.change_order_priced_by: The pricer is recorded when the change order is marked priced.
refusals.change_order_state_conflict: Someone else changed this change order first. Refresh to see its state.
refusals.change_order_transition_not_allowed: A change order cannot move to that state from here.
refusals.change_order_unpriced: Every line needs a price, or No cost, before the change order is priced.
refusals.change_order_use_rpc: Price and approve a change order with its own actions.
refusals.contingency_exhausted: The draw exceeds the contingency remaining.
refusals.contingency_source: Draws come from a Contingency line.
refusals.contingency_target: Draws go to a non-contingency line of the same budget.
refusals.contingency_unpriced: An unpriced contingency has nothing to draw. Price it first.
refusals.counterparty_name_required: A new counterparty needs the company's name.
refusals.expense_budget_line_immutable: An expense posts to exactly one budget line, which never changes.
refusals.expense_currency: The expense must be in its budget's currency.
refusals.expense_locked: An expense's amount and date change only while it is submitted.
refusals.expense_state_conflict: Someone else decided this expense first. Refresh to see its state.
refusals.expense_submitter_immutable: The submitter of an expense never changes.
refusals.expense_transition_not_allowed: An expense cannot move to that state from here.
refusals.expense_use_approval_rpc: Approve or reject an expense with its own actions.
refusals.gl_account_unresolved: No expense account resolves for this line's URID class.
refusals.invoice_direction: Receivable invoices are issued; payable invoices are approved.
refusals.invoice_immutable: An invoice keeps its project, direction, counterparty and currency.
refusals.invoice_line_budget: An invoice line bills against a budget line of the invoice's project.
refusals.invoice_line_dimension_missing: Each invoice line needs a URID or a budget line before it posts to the ledger.
refusals.invoice_line_immutable: A line stays on its invoice.
refusals.invoice_locked: Invoice lines change only while the invoice is a draft.
refusals.invoice_needs_account: Invoices come from an external account; the engagement has none.
refusals.invoice_overpaid: An invoice is never paid beyond its total.
refusals.invoice_state_conflict: Someone else changed this invoice first. Refresh to see its state.
refusals.invoice_transition_not_allowed: An invoice cannot move to that state from here.
refusals.invoice_unpriced: Every line needs a price before the invoice is issued or approved.
refusals.invoice_use_rpc: Issue or approve an invoice with its own actions.
refusals.journal_line_entry_immutable: A journal line stays on its entry.
refusals.journal_period_dates: The entry date must fall inside the entry's accounting period.
refusals.journal_posted_immutable: A posted or canceled entry never changes; prepare a reversing entry instead.
refusals.journal_preparer_immutable: The preparer of a journal entry never changes.
refusals.journal_state_conflict: Someone else changed this entry first. Refresh to see its state.
refusals.journal_transition_not_allowed: A journal entry cannot move to that state from here.
refusals.journal_unbalanced: An entry posts only when its debits equal its credits in one currency.
refusals.accounting_period_state_conflict: Someone else moved this period first. Refresh to see its state.
refusals.accounting_period_transition_not_allowed: A period reaches Audited only through Closed, one step at a time.
refusals.payment_applied: Remove the payment's applications before canceling it.
refusals.payment_application_immutable: An application is removed and recorded again, never edited.
refusals.payment_application_mismatch: A payment settles invoices of the same counterparty, direction and currency.
refusals.payment_application_state: Apply live payments to issued or approved invoices.
refusals.payment_immutable: A payment keeps its counterparty, direction, currency and amount; cancel it and record another.
refusals.payment_overapplied: A payment is never applied beyond its amount.
refusals.payment_state_conflict: Someone else changed this payment first. Refresh to see its state.
refusals.payment_transition_not_allowed: A payment cannot move to that state from here.
refusals.payroll_line_role_missing: Every payroll line needs a canon role before the run posts.
refusals.period_closed: That period is Closed, Audited or Archived and refuses postings. Use an open period.
refusals.period_dates_locked: A period's dates change only while it is Open.
refusals.period_missing: No accounting period covers that date. Open one in Periods before posting.
refusals.period_overlap: Accounting periods never overlap. Choose dates outside the existing periods.
refusals.period_unposted_entries: Post or cancel every prepared journal entry in the period before closing it.
refusals.production_closed: This production is closed and refuses new finance documents.
refusals.report_run_unfinished: Only a finished report run can be shared. Wait for the run to succeed.
refusals.self_billing_currency: The engagement has no currency. Set its rate and currency first.
refusals.self_billing_disabled: Self-billing is off for this project. Turn it on in Legal Entities and Fiscal settings.
refusals.self_billing_not_agreed: The party has not agreed to self-billing on this engagement; they agree in Gateway.
refusals.self_billing_nothing_to_bill: No approved timesheets or accepted milestones in this period are waiting to be billed.
refusals.self_billing_period: Choose a period whose end is on or after its start.
refusals.settlement_immutable: A settlement keeps its engagement, project, number and currency.
refusals.settlement_line_immutable: A line stays on its settlement.
refusals.settlement_locked: Settlement lines change only while it is a draft. Rework it first.
refusals.settlement_state_conflict: Someone else changed this settlement first. Refresh to see its state.
refusals.settlement_transition_not_allowed: A settlement cannot move to that state from here.
refusals.settlement_unpriced: Every settlement line needs an amount before the settlement is submitted.
refusals.settlement_use_rpc: The party accepts or disputes a submitted settlement in Gateway.
refusals.share_already_revoked: This report is no longer shared.
refusals.share_expiry_past: A share expires in the future. Choose a later date or none.
refusals.sod_approval_requester: An approval is decided by an eligible approver, never the person who recorded it.
refusals.sod_change_order_requester: The requester of a change order cannot price and approve it alone. Ask another approver.
refusals.sod_expense_submitter: The submitter of an expense cannot approve it. Ask another approver.
refusals.sod_journal_preparer: The preparer of a journal entry cannot post it. Ask another poster.
refusals.sod_po_creator: The creator of a purchase order cannot approve it.
refusals.sod_self_grant: A person cannot set a limit or grant that applies to themselves.
refusals.sod_vendor_payment: A person who created a vendor or edited its bank details cannot approve payment to it.
refusals.spend_approval_duplicate: You already approved this. A second approval needs a different approver.
refusals.spend_authority_exceeded: This exceeds your spend authority. Route it to the next approver in the policy.
refusals.spend_authority_missing: No spend authority lets you approve this document type in this currency. Ask an Admin to set one.
refusals.spend_unpriced: An unpriced amount cannot be approved. Price it first.
refusals.tax_rate_overlap: Rates of one tax jurisdiction and tax type never overlap.
refusals.tax_type_unknown: That is not a canon tax type.
refusals.transition_reason_required: Every state change needs a reason.
refusals.urid_unknown: That URID is not a canon discipline or category.
refusals.invoice_payment_state: Record a payment against an approved payable or an issued receivable.
refusals.invoice_payment_amount: Nothing is left to pay on this invoice.
refusals.invoice_payment_date: Give the date the money moved.
refusals.payment_payee_not_engaged: A payment to a person pays someone this organization engages as an individual.
refusals.invoice_engagement_payee: The payee of an engagement invoice is the engaged party: its account, or the person when no account bills.
refusals.invoice_engagement_project: An invoice bills an engagement of its own project.
refusals.export_restricted: This file carries Restricted tax identifiers. Ask an Owner or Admin with the restricted export capability.
refusals.step_up_required: Exporting Restricted data needs step-up authentication. Sign in again with your second factor, then download.
refusals.form_1099_year: Choose a tax year from 2020 to this year.
refusals.deliverable_fee_fixed: An accepted milestone keeps its fee.
refusals.deliverable_fee_currency: Set the engagement's currency before pricing its milestones.
refusals.sod_document_creator: Your organization does not let the person who created a document approve it. Ask another approver.
refusals.sod_change_order_requester_steps: Your organization does not let the requester of a change order decide any step of its approval. Ask another approver.
